name: DividendTerms
description: Information related to dividends and payments.

dividendEntitlement.description: Defines the date on which the receiver of the equity return is entitled to the dividend.

manufacturedIncomeRequirement.description: Specifies the proportion of the value of the dividend on the borrowed shares that the borrower is legally obligated to return to the lender.

minimumBillingAmount.description: daily fee increments accrue until a threshold is crossed, at which point payment becomes due)
